description: This source file implements the SetVolume class for the webAudio task in the Rialto server project. It manages setting the volume of a WebAudio player using GStreamer wrappers.

classes.name: SetVolume
classes.description: A class responsible for setting the volume of a WebAudio player in the Rialto server's webAudio task.

methods.name: SetVolume
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SetVolume object with the WebAudio player context, GStreamer wrapper, and desired volume.

methods.name: ~SetVolume
methods.description: Destructor that logs the completion of the SetVolume object lifecycle.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the volume setting operation by calling the GStreamer wrapper to set the stream volume.
